SPECIFICATION FOR ACCESSORIES TO MECHANICAL VENTILATION SYSTEMS ON BOARD SHIPS
PART II SMOKE PROTECTING FLAP VALVES

0.

FOREWORD

0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 11 December 1970, after the draft finalized by the Shipbuilding Sectional Committee had been approved by the hlechanical Engineering Division Council. 0.2 Smoke protecting flap valves are provided in the ventilation systems on board ships so as to eliminate spread of fire hazards from one compartment to the other. 0.3 Smoke protecting flap valves are required to be fitted in mechanical ventilation systems on board ships under the statutory regulations. When local control of smoke protecting flap valves are required to be operated from both sides of a bulkhead or division, flap valves are fitted on either side of the bulkhead with provision for local control. 0.4 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test, shall be rounded off in accordance with The number of significant places retained in the rounded off IS : 2-1960*. value sllould be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.
